title: seseli elbursense
intro: Seseli elbursense, commonly known as Elburz Seseli, is a type of flowering plant in the carrot family (Apiaceae). It is native to mountainous regions of Iran and has been used in traditional medicine for its medicinal properties. The health benefits of Seseli elbursense include its anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, which can help to protect against various diseases. The therapeutic actions of this plant include its ability to reduce pain, fight infections, and protect against oxidative stress, attributed to its bioactive constituents such as sesquiterpene lactones and other volatile compounds.
